5224646.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Enchanting Christmas light
- Amazing infinity tunnel effect
- UK mains powered with 5m cable
- Double-sided for front and back viewing

## Information
Create a magical, mesmerising Christmas display with our Candle Bridge Infinity Light. Shaped like a candle bridge and lighted by LEDs, it measures H40cm and is perfect for indoor display. When switched on, mirrors reflect the LEDs to create a never-ending reflection of the candle light. Fun, bright, and colourful, it looks amazing display with other infinity lights from our range. The infinity tunnel light is mains powered rather than battery powered to produce a stronger, brighter glow. Powered by an IP20-rated UK 3-pin transformer plug for indoor sockets only. The plug has a 5m cable which is clear to blend in more discreetly with its surroundings. At 5m long, it gives you plenty of flexibility when displaying the light on a inside your home. Seeing is believing with our infinity light. By creating an endless tunnel of light, the mirror and LEDs produce a magnificent 3D-style effect. Perfect for giving your home the wow factor at Christmas. A sturdy wooden base allows you to easily display the infinity light on a table, windowsill, or mantlepiece. Because the base is white, it looks discreet at night, so it doesnt detract your attention.

8524446.sourceDescription:
## Features
- 3 lighting options - White, Warm White & both
- 8 hour timer (16 hours off)
- 12 white ground pegs and 6 while cable ties
- 250  LED lights
- Suitable for indoor and outdoor use
- 10m transparent lead cable

## Information
The Christmas Centre's White Wire Light Up Christmas Reindeer Mother & Baby will look great in any home's festive display either indoors or outdoors. These beautiful, white wire reindeers have 250 LED Warm White and Bright White lights between them. Twelve white pegs are included to attach both deer to the lawn to keep them from falling over. The 10m lead cable provides enough length to reach your nearest electric socket. Comes with 3 lighting options: white, warm white, or morphing between the two and includes 6 white cable tie accessories. The integrated timer goes on for 8 hours, then off for 16 hours every 24 hour cycle. So, once your reindeer is switched on at the time you want, you can sit back and enjoy without having to lift another finger. Mother dimensions: 69cm (H) x 100cm (L) x 20cm (D). Baby dimensions: 39cm (H) x 40cm (L) x 9cm (D).
